description: Over the first 8,000 lines of a real compile log (develop e515ae314, AOT build) the fz output differs from Elixir's in the wake table: fz prints extra rows and a wider 'completing job' column. Both exit 1 with the same MISMATCH line (the trace is truncated), so the difference is in the table, not the exit. The pinned test covers only the 112 KB main_returns_one.jsonl. Repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/slow/h8000.jsonl, out8000.txt (fz), ex8000.txt (elixir). Minimize to a fixture and fix.
title: The distiller prints what Elixir prints over a large trace
